product.description: 20 de exerciții de respirație și de relaxare simple și ușor de înțeles, pe care le vei deprinde într-o clipă! Fiecare exercițiu este explicat în detaliu, pas cu pas, și ilustrat într-o manieră clară și modernă. Exercițiile sunt propuse de Isabelle Koch, absolventă a Federației Franceze de Hatha-Yoga și profesoară de yoga pasionată, cu o experiență de 30 de ani atât în lucrul cu adulții, cât și cu copiii.

# SIMPLISSIME: The Simplest Yoga Book for Kids

Introducing **SIMPLISSIME**, the guide designed to make starting a yoga practice fun, easy, and accessible. Created specifically for children, this book offers a gentle introduction to mindfulness, movement, and relaxation through play. It is an essential resource for parents looking to introduce breathing exercises and simple yoga routines into their child's daily life.

*Price: 44.99*

## Discover Gentle Movement and Relaxation

Are you looking for an engaging way to help your child relax and improve focus? *SIMPLISSIME* provides exactly that. This book details **20 easy-to-follow breathing and relaxation exercises**. Each routine is explained step-by-step and beautifully illustrated, ensuring that even beginners can grasp the concepts immediately.

The content focuses on simple yet profound techniques, making it an ideal tool for building body awareness and teaching calming habits in a modern, child-friendly format.

### What Makes This Yoga Guide Unique?

*   **Simple to Understand:** The exercises are broken down into clear, manageable steps, perfect for children aged all stages of learning.
*   **Focus on Breathing:** Emphasis is placed on simple breathing techniques and overall relaxation, helping to manage stress naturally.
*   **Modern & Clear Illustrations:** Beautifully designed visuals accompany every exercise, enhancing the learning experience without being overwhelming.

## Expertise You Can Trust

This guide was developed by Isabelle Koch, a dedicated yoga professional with deep expertise in working with both adults and children.

Isabelle is an alumna of the French Federation of Hatha Yoga and brings 30 years of experience to this book. Her passion for teaching shines through every page, ensuring that the techniques are not only simple but also effective and safe for young practitioners.

## Who Needs SIMPLISSIME?

*   Parents seeking fun activities to improve their child's sleep quality or focus.
*   Teachers looking for gentle movement break ideas in a classroom setting.
*   Anyone interested in integrating basic mindfulness and yoga into family routines.

***

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this book suitable for very young children?**
A: The exercises are designed to be simple and easy to follow, making them adaptable for various age groups who can participate with guidance from a parent or caregiver.

**Q: Does the book require prior yoga knowledge?**
A: No! *SIMPLISSIME* is explicitly marketed as the "simplest" guide, meaning it assumes no prior knowledge and provides detailed instructions for every exercise.

***

Ready to start your journey into simple fun and mindful movement? Get your copy of **SIMPLISSIME** today!
